$comment: Plugin pack: opencode-voice — local speech-to-text (whisper.cpp via sox) + optional Piper TTS (github.com/renjfk/opencode-voice). Unlike MCP packs, this pack carries a 'tui' key: deploy/merge-packs.mjs deep-merges it into ~/.config/opencode/tui.json (--tui-config), merging the plugin array BY PLUGIN NAME so other plugins are preserved (idempotent re-runs replace in place). Host prereqs (sox, whisper-cli, whisper model) are handled by setup.sh install_voice / setup.ps1 note when this pack is requested. Normalization defaults to a local Ollama endpoint — edit endpoint/model in the deployed tui.json to point at any OpenAI-compatible API (Anthropic, OpenAI, LM Studio, llama.cpp); omit apiKeyEnv for unauthenticated endpoints. Not useful inside Docker (no microphone): without --tui-config the tui merge is skipped with a warning.
